title: The Adjustment Bureau
tagline: Fate has a plan. So does dessert.
about: A politician falls for a dancer while mysterious men try to keep them apart.
cue: Serve the snacks when David meets Elise on the bus.
faces: Tuesday, November 7, 2006. A reception for Norris for Senate.
The gentlemen’s lounge off the ballroom, our quietest room.
Almonds, cashews and pecans glazed with honey, butter and cinnamon.
Toasted baguette, whipped chèvre, warm honey, thyme and cracked pepper.
Thick cucumber rounds, crème fraîche whipped with lemon, fresh dill.
Nuts served warm in paper cones. Late supper and the bar overleaf.
In the ballroom foyer from 11 P.M.
Seared sirloin, shallot and red wine butter, double-fried potatoes.
Split tails, garlic, chilli, cherry tomatoes and white wine.
Dark chocolate, baked to order, set at the edges, soft in the centre.
Poured at the table. Mind your shirt.
Gin, lemon and sugar, shaken, topped with brut champagne.
Whatever the count says, thank you. Eat something, the returns run late. Hats to the cloakroom, and no photographs at the bar. The bus back to Brooklyn leaves the side doors at 1 A.M.
A private wedding is also with us tonight. Kindly keep to the ballroom.
Service doors are for staff only. The Hotel Carrow.
